'''Nolor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who fought during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Near the end of the conflict, he fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] while fighting the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces, and he became a fugitive after the declaration of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]&mdash;[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] directive to eliminate all [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Nolor was hunted down by members of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]], a group of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]] who served the newly-formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and they persuaded him to join them.

After training to be an interrogator, Nolor was assigned to join the [[Sarlacc Project]], a secret initiative to build a [[Super Star Destroyer prototype]]. From the project's base in [[Imeici Spire]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Nolor would extract knowledge from the minds of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Engineer/Legends|designers]], used to help design the gigantic [[Starship/Legends|vessel]]. When members of the anti-Imperial [[Alderaanian Resistance]] group [[Mission to Coruscant (Imperial era)|infiltrated]] Imeici Spire, Nolor was sent with two [[apprentice Inquisitor]]s and two [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guards]] to deal with them. However, he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the resulting fight.

==Biography==
Nolor was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and, as a young adult, he fought during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="TCOC" /> a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]]-scale conflict fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> However, near to the end of the war, he fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] while fighting the Separatists. Shortly afterward, he narrowly avoided [[Death/Legends|death]] during [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]<ref name="TCOC" />&mdash;the directive issued by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to the Republic's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to eliminate all [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Nolor became a fugitive and was hunted down by some of the earliest members of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]],<ref name="TCOC" /> an order of [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adepts]] who served the newly-formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TDSS">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref> They saw his potential to be a member of their order, so they persuaded Nolor to join them and serve the Empire.<ref name="TCOC" />

[[File:Sarlaccproject.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Nolor participated in the Sarlacc Project, building a Super Star Destroyer prototype.]]
After being molded by the Inquisitorius into an adept interrogator, Nolor was assigned to become part of the [[Sarlacc Project]], an Imperial effort to build a [[Super Star Destroyer prototype]]. He, along with other members of the Inquisitorius, worked at the administrative base for the project, [[Imeici Spire]], a recently-constructed tower located in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] district of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Using his [[The Force/Legends|Force-aided]] interrogation skills, Nolor would extract knowledge from the minds of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designers held captive there, and this information would be used to formulate designs for the gigantic prototype.<ref name="TCOC" />

In circa [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the anti-Imperial [[Alderaanian Resistance]] group [[Mission to Coruscant (Imperial era)|sent a team of agents]] to Coruscant to determine where the Sarlacc Project was based. They broke into Imeici Spire, and, after their security breach was detected by the Imperials, Nolor was sent to deal with them. Along with two [[apprentice Inquisitor]]s and two [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guards]]&mdash;members of an elite [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] division&mdash;Nolor confronted the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanians]] on Level 188 of the tower, an area still under construction. While the apprentice Inquisitors and Coruscant Guards arrived on the level using service lifts, Nolor approached the Alderaanians from a stairway. He began attacking them by [[Telekinesis/Legends|hurling]] a large object at them with the Force, while at the same time using the Force to choke one of them. However, Nolor was eventually defeated and killed, and Imeici Spire was destroyed after its [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct sequence]] was initiated during the fight.<ref name="TCOC" />

==Personality and traits==
Nolor was covered in scars from the battles he had fought in. As an Inquisitor, he wore black robes that were trimmed with crimson, with no cape or hood, allowing his scars to be easily seen. He was armed with a red-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] that he had built himself, although he also carried a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. He was a skilled interrogator and this made him ideally suited to the job of extracting information from the minds of the Sarlacc Project designers.<ref name="TCOC" />

==Powers and abilities==
When in combat, Nolor tried to use his skills in Force-guided interrogation to give him an advantage over those he was fighting. Another favored tactic of his was to use a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] on one target, while simultaneously using his telekinesis abilities to hurl small objects at another. He also knew how to use the Force to choke people and how to [[Force Enrage|call upon the dark side]] to enhance his [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] temporarily. Nolor was multilingual, and, in addition to [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], he could also speak [[Bocce/Legends|Bocce]] and [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]].<ref name="TCOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nolor was created by writer [[Sterling Hershey]] and made his first and only appearance in ''[[The Core of Corruption]]'', the sixth scenario in the ''[[Dawn of Defiance]]'' campaign, a [[Wizards of the Coast]] online supplement to the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. In the supplement, the Alderaanian agents are player characters and their fight with Nolor can be resolved in a number of ways. When Nolor first enters the fight, the object he throws at the group is either a large beam or a metal plate. If Nolor is the last Inquisitor left standing, he then fights to the death, and just as he is about to be defeated, he triggers the tower's self-destruct sequence. Even if the players do not kill him, he dies when the tower collapses. It is also possible for the players to capture him, but if they do so, the self-destruct sequence is initiated by one of the other Inquisitors, and Nolor is still killed.<ref name="TCOC" />
